useCase.name: Record that a student did not sit a paper, and set what that absence does to their result
useCase.featureRef: 6.15 Recording a student absent from an exam

intent.name: exam.paper.attendance.mark
intent.summary: Mark who sat a paper and who did not. One step, and absent is a state, never a score of zero.

routesHere.text: maths ke paper ki hazri laga do
routesHere.gloss: mark the attendance for the maths paper

routesHere.text: teen bache paper mein nahi aaye
routesHere.gloss: three students did not come for the paper

routesHere.text: hall ki hazri darj kar do

request.text: ghair haazir bache ke sifar laga do
request.gloss: put a zero for the absent student

routesElsewhere.note: Absent is a state on the mark, not a score of zero. A zero says they sat the paper and answered nothing (BR-3).

request.text: ghair haaziri ki wajah tay karo
request.gloss: decide the reason for the absence

routesElsewhere.note: The Coordinator classifies the absence as excused or unexcused, and an Invigilator cannot (BR-5, E5).

request.gloss: mark attendance for the online paper

routesElsewhere.note: For an online exam a student whose attempt was never started is recorded absent automatically. There is nobody in a hall to observe it (BR-2).

steps.note: One step. Every student entered for the paper is marked present or absent — a student unaccounted for is not the same as a student who did not come (BR-1).

plan.onFailure: Stop and report. A student left unmarked, and attendance for a paper not yet sat, arrive as errors.
plan.atomicity: One write: the attendance and the audit entry together or not at all. An absent student's marks field is closed and no grace can be awarded to them (BR-3, BR-4). The guardian is told their child missed the paper (BR-10) — a family learning only at the report card that a paper was missed has been failed. The absence does nothing to the result until the Coordinator classifies it (BR-6, BR-12).

operations.name: exam.paper.attendance.mark

operations.purpose: Mark every student entered for the paper present or absent.

resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the candidates with their exam, subject, class and date.

parameters.notes: A scheduled paper of a published exam, already sat (E7).

parameters.name: attendance
parameters.notes: Per student: Present or Absent, and optionally a note of up to 250 characters on what the invigilator observed. Every student on the list carries one (BR-1, E1). The invigilator's own observation — a planner that filled in Present for the unnamed rest has said a child sat a paper.

fields.description: Each absence, awaiting classification by the Coordinator (BR-12).

fields.description: Absent students holding approved leave covering the paper date. Shown to the Coordinator so an absence the school already sanctioned is not classified unexcused by mistake (BR-5).

errors.meaning: A student on the list was left unmarked.
errors.note: The message names the students. A student unaccounted for is not the same as a student who did not come (BR-1).

errors.meaning: The paper has not yet been sat.

planningRules.rule: Never mark a student present who was not named. It says a child sat a paper, and it closes the question of why a missing script is missing.
Never record a zero instead of an absence. A zero says they sat the paper and answered nothing (BR-3), and an illness recorded as a failure is exactly what this use case exists to prevent.
Never classify the absence in the same breath. The Coordinator decides whether it is excused, and that decision changes the result (BR-5, BR-6, E5).
Report the students holding approved leave for that date. It is shown so an absence the school already sanctioned is not classified as unexcused by mistake (BR-5).
Say plainly that the family is told. The guardian learns their child missed the paper as soon as this is saved (BR-10), which the invigilator marking a register may not expect.
Never mark online-exam attendance. A student whose attempt was never started is recorded absent automatically, because there is nobody in a hall to observe it (BR-2).
branch_id comes from $session.

reversal.statement: Correcting the attendance where the hall record was wrong, with the original kept. A student wrongly marked absent must not have to appeal a grade to fix a clerical error (BR-11).

resolvedPlans.outcome: Recorded. Report that the three families are told now (PR-5), that any of the three holding approved leave is flagged for the Coordinator (PR-4), and that nothing happens to their results until the absence is classified (PR-3).

resolvedPlans.outcome: Attendance recorded. Report that the Coordinator classifies each absence with a reason — and that any approved leave covering the date is shown to them, so a sanctioned absence is not marked unexcused by mistake.

intent.name: exam.absence.classify
intent.summary: Classify an exam absence as excused or unexcused, with the reason, which decides what it does to the result. Coordinator only, one step.
routesHere: classify this absence as excused — the student was on approved leave

routesHere.text: ghair haaziri ko excused kar do, wajah ke sath
routesHere.gloss: classify the absence as excused, with the reason
the child was ill, mark it excused

routesHere.text: koi wajah nahi thi, unexcused karo
routesHere.gloss: there was no reason, mark it unexcused

routesHere: classify it and allow a makeup

routesElsewhere.note: An absence with no classification blocks the result from being finalised. An unclassified absence is a decision nobody has taken (BR-12, E6).
The classification records whether a makeup is allowed. Arranging and sitting it is a separate act (BR-9).

request.text: natije mein is ka asar khud tay karo
request.gloss: set what it does to the result separately

routesElsewhere.note: The result treatment is derived from the classification, never chosen separately (BR-6).

steps.note: One step, and it decides the result. An excused absence leaves that subject out of the overall percentage and marks the result incomplete until a makeup is taken; an unexcused one counts as zero (BR-6).

plan.onFailure: Stop and report. A classification with no reason, and an attempt by an Invigilator, arrive as errors.
plan.atomicity: One write: the classification, its reason, the result treatment it implies and the message to the guardian together or not at all. Either classification leaves the student out of that exam's merit list until every subject carries a final mark (BR-8). The family is told the classification once it is set (BR-10).

operations.name: exam.absence.classify
operations.idempotencyKey: absence_id, since an absence carries one classification at a time
operations.purpose: Classify an exam absence as excused or unexcused, with the reason.

parameters.name: absence_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No unclassified absence matches for that student and paper.
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the candidates with the student, the paper, the date and any approved leave.

parameters.notes: The recorded absence, from the student and the paper.

parameters.name: classification
parameters.notes: What the absence was (BR-5). It decides the result (BR-6) — an excused absence is left out of the percentage, an unexcused one counts as zero — so it is never assumed from approved leave or from anything else.

parameters.name: reason
parameters.notes: 20 to 500 characters. Required (E4). Why the absence is excused or not, which is what the family is told (BR-10).

parameters.name: makeup_allowed
parameters.notes: Whether a makeup is offered (BR-9). Arranging and sitting it is a separate act; this records the decision.

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

returns.description: The classification and what it does.

fields.name: reason

fields.name: makeup_allowed

The classification was changed after a makeup was scheduled.

planningRules.rule: Never choose the classification. It decides whether a missed paper is left out of the percentage or counted as zero (BR-6) — a planner that picked excused because leave existed has made the school's decision about a child.
Report the approved leave rather than acting on it. It is shown so a sanctioned absence is not classified unexcused by mistake (BR-5), which is a prompt to the Coordinator and not a classification.
Never compose the reason. The family is told it (BR-10), and a reason a planner wrote is the school explaining a child's missed paper in words nobody chose.
Never set the result treatment separately. It is derived from the classification and never chosen (BR-6) — two fields that could disagree would let a paper be excused and counted as zero at once.
Say plainly that the student stays out of the merit list either way, until every subject carries a final mark. A family expecting a position after an excused absence will not get one (BR-8).
Report where a makeup was already scheduled and the classification has changed. It is flagged for review rather than silently invalidated (E8), and somebody has to look at it.
branch_id comes from $session.

reversal.statement: A classification is set again rather than withdrawn, and the change is recorded. Where a makeup was already scheduled, it is flagged for review rather than silently invalidated (E8).

intent.name: exam.paper.attendance.correct
intent.summary: Correct a paper attendance mark where the hall record was wrong, keeping the original. One step.
routesHere: this student was marked absent in error — they sat the paper

routesHere.text: is bache ko ghalti se ghair haazir laga diya tha
routesHere.gloss: this student was marked absent by mistake

routesHere.text: hall ka record ghalat tha, theek kar do
routesHere.gloss: the hall record was wrong, correct it

routesHere.text: bacha paper mein tha, hazri theek karo
routesHere.gloss: the child was there for the paper, fix the attendance

request.text: ghair haaziri ki wajah badal do
request.gloss: change the reason for the absence

routesElsewhere.note: Correcting the mark says the child was there. Classifying says why they were not.
Correcting the attendance opens the marks field. Entering the score is the teacher's separate act.

steps.note: One step. A student wrongly marked absent must not have to appeal a grade to fix a clerical error (BR-11).

plan.atomicity: One write: the corrected mark, the original kept beside it, and the audit entry together or not at all (BR-11). Where a student is corrected from absent to present their marks field opens and any recorded absence is withdrawn — the classification and anything derived from it go with it. Where a makeup had been scheduled on that absence, it is flagged for review rather than silently invalidated (E8).

operations.name: exam.paper.attendance.correct
operations.idempotencyKey: paper_id + student_id + attendance, since a repeat must not stack correction records
operations.purpose: Correct one student's paper attendance, keeping the original mark.

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No scheduled paper matches within the actor's scope.
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the candidates with their exam, subject, class and date.

parameters.name: student_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No student on that paper's list matches.
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the candidates with their roll number and current mark.

parameters.notes: The student whose mark was wrong.

parameters.name: reason
parameters.notes: Maximum 250 characters. Why the hall record was wrong. It sits beside the original mark (BR-11).

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

fields.name: student_id
fields.description: The student.

fields.name: previous_attendance
fields.description: What the hall record said, kept (BR-11).

fields.name: attendance
fields.description: What it says now.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: As given.

fields.name: marks_field_open
fields.description: True where the student is now present. Their score can be entered (BR-3).

fields.name: absence_withdrawn
fields.description: True where a recorded absence and its classification are withdrawn with the correction.

fields.name: makeup_flagged_for_review
fields.description: True where a makeup had been scheduled on the withdrawn absence (E8).

fields.name: guardian_notified
fields.description: Where the family had been told the child missed the paper, they are told of the correction (BR-10).

errors.meaning: The correction matches what the record already says.
A correction was made with no reason.

planningRules.rule: Never compose the reason. It sits beside the original mark for as long as the record exists (BR-11), and it is what explains a changed attendance to anybody who asks.
Never correct an attendance to make a mark enterable. The correction says a child sat a paper, and that is a statement about the hall, not a route to an open marks field.
Report the classification withdrawn with the correction. A decision about why a child missed a paper falls away when it turns out they did not (BR-6).
Report where a makeup had been scheduled. It is flagged for review rather than silently invalidated (E8), and a child may be expecting to sit a paper they no longer need.
Say that the family is told again. They were told the paper was missed (BR-10); they are owed the correction just as plainly.
branch_id comes from $session.

reversal.statement: A correction is not undone. A further change is another correction, each recorded with its own previous value and reason (BR-11).
